ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both parties.

To the rider: I have read your account of being taken through back roads near Bukit Timah and of a fare higher than your usual. The evidence, however, does not show a route deviation as the policy defines one. The booked optimal route for this trip (TRP-00301) is 14.2 km (trip_record.optimal_distance_km). The driver's GPS trace, which is the governing distance figure under POL-RD-01, measures the trip at 16.5 km (gps_trace.trace_distance_km). The excess is therefore 2.3 km, which is 16.2% of the optimal distance. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms. The 2.3 km clears the 0.8 km limb comfortably, but 16.2% does not clear the 20% limb, and both limbs must pass. POL-RD-01 is explicit that where either test fails, no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. So the charge stands as recorded: charged_total SGD 24.74, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00. I note you described paying $25.63; the fare ledger records SGD 24.74 and no ERP or surcharges, and the figure the policy works from is the ledger figure.

For transparency: had a deviation been established, the arithmetic under POL-RD-02 would have produced a recomputed fare of SGD 21.13 (base 3.80 plus 0.75 x 14.2 km plus 0.28 x 21.0 min, at the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from the fare breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP or airport surcharge) and a refund of SGD 3.61, rounded up to SGD 3.65. That computation is contingent on a deviation being established, and it is not, so no refund issues.

On your two further points: (1) Your request that the driver be flagged cannot be granted. POL-RD-06 is engaged only on a MATERIAL deviation (over 50% or 8.0 km), which this 16.2% excess does not approach, and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 260, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no conduct referral is available. (2) Your reference to other trips by other drivers concerns no artifact of this trip and cannot support a finding here.

To the driver: your statement that you took the Braddell exit and went 'maybe one or two km more' is consistent with the measured 2.3 km excess, and I have treated it as an admission of the extra distance. It does not change the outcome, because the POL-RD-01 threshold is a numeric gate and the percentage limb is not met. Your reference to a jam near Toa Payoh cannot be run: no traffic advisory covers this trip. The artifact EV-ADVIS-00301-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and can carry no fact; its absence is a gap in the bundle, and because you cited no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) confirms this is not an escalation trigger under POL-RD-10(5). The case is therefore decided on the trace.

On the integrity of the evidence: the GPS trace is complete and unimpaired (167 fixes at a 10 second cadence, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0 seconds), so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is engaged and no corroboration question arises. The trip identifiers match across the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown, so POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied. The rider profile (deviation_claims_60d 0) does not trigger the corroboration overlay in POL-RD-08, and no context-only profile field has been used as a ground of decision.

The prevailing charge was SGD 24.74 and the amount contested in this dispute was SGD 3.50. No amount is refunded and no driver compensation is payable. This ruling leaves the present state of the fare as it is, and it is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. Because no monetary effect moves, the ruling falls below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold and requires no hold.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider and the driver: this is a provisional ruling. Both advocates' arithmetic is correct, and I adopt it.

THE DEVIATION. On this trip's own evidence the route deviation is established. EV-GPS-00302 (the driver's trace) records 28.2 km against the booked optimal of 22.0 km on EV-TRIP-00302 — an excess of 6.2 km, or 28.18%. That clears both POL-RD-01 gates (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%). The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 235 fixes, 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps, so the 28.2 km measurement stands. The excess does not, however, reach materiality (8.0 km or 50%), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged: the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the 3 the clause requires and below the 0.05 ratio over at least 40 trips (1/70). No remedy uplift and no driver-conduct referral arise. I note the driver claim that mentions prior_deviation_flags: that lifetime counter is context only under POL-GEN-01 and is not used for any finding.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE. The driver says the SLE was heavy at the CTE merge. That is an asserted external traffic cause and is tested against this trip's traffic advisory only. The sole such artifact, EV-ADVIS-00302-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). Under POL-RD-13 the comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the excuse carries no weight; the deviation stands at the measured 6.2 km. The driver's assertion cites no advisory identifier, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged and this is not an escalation. Equally, the missing artifact carries no fact against the driver.

THE FARE. The fare model on EV-FARE-00302 is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. Recomputed fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 22.0 km + 0.28 x 28.0 min) x 1.2 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.50 on-optimal-route ERP = 36.068. Charged total = 48.34. Refund = 48.34 - 36.068 = 12.272, rounded up to SGD 12.30. The surge multiplier of 1.2 was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00302 and inflates both sides of the subtraction; it does not explain the gap. The refund is above the 0.50 de-minimis and only 25.4% of the charge, well short of the 90% that would make it a full refund.

THE ERP. Three gantries were billed, 4.50 in total: BKE 1.50 (on the optimal route) and two CTE gantries at 2.00 and 1.00 (off it). Under POL-RD-09(1) the off-route 3.00 is already comprehended in the 12.30 recomputation, which counts only the on-route gantry. It is itemised for transparency but is not added on top. Both CTE crossings are genuine (nearest fixes 0.0 m), so there is no billing-integrity correction and no referral under POL-RD-09(4).

No rider-requested detour (EV-CHAT-00302 is empty), no pickup or dropoff amendment, and no pooled itinerary bear on the result.

OUTCOME. The rider is refunded SGD 12.30 of the 15.00 contested. Because that exceeds the automatic execution threshold of SGD 8.00, the amount is issued but held for release by a human reviewer rather than executed automatically. My confidence is 0.90, capped by the 1.0 weight of the artifacts that carry the deciding facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Rider and driver: this is a route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-00303 (Hougang Mall to Novena Square). The fare charged was SGD 18.05 and the rider contests SGD 4.00. The rider is partly right.

The threshold. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be measured on the GPS trace, not on the trip record's rounded convenience copy, and it says so expressly. The trace reads 11.43 km against a 9.5 km optimal, an excess of 1.93 km and 20.32%. Both establishment tests pass together: more than 0.8 km and more than 20%. A deviation is therefore established. The driver's submission that 11.4 km against 9.5 km is “exactly 20 percent” is arithmetically true of the 11.4 figure, but 11.4 is the rounded copy POL-RD-01 forbids citing for the threshold test; on the governing trace figure the gate is crossed by 0.32 of a percentage point. The driver's contrary argument is rejected on that ground alone.

The remedy. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 9.5 + 0.28 x 13.0) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee = 15.365. charged_total is 18.05, so the refund is 2.685, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 2.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so the driver's NO_ACTION submission fails, and it is far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND rather than FULL_REFUND. Both advocates' arithmetic on this figure agrees and is accepted.

No uplift and no referral. The excess is 20.32%, far below the 50% or 8.0 km marks for a MATERIAL deviation, so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is not engaged and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available on this trip's own evidence. Even if the profile were consulted, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 260 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established. The lifetime counters and all other profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry no finding. No ERP, toll, airport-surcharge or waiting-time line exists on this fare (all 0.00), so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and produces no billing-integrity referral. The billed-distance shortfall against the trace is 0.03 km, far below the 1.0 km that would open POL-RD-04 driver compensation, so driver_compensation_sgd is null.

Exculpatory grounds. The driver's account that he took Upper Serangoon then Bendemeer is an assertion that his route was normal and cites no traffic advisory. The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00303-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and no advisory covers this corridor in this window, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The chat log is empty, so POL-RD-04 is not in play; no endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 is not in play; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not pooled, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and the fare is METERED, not upfront, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. The trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07 — 106 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 seconds — so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required.

The driver's point that the fare breakdown carries no pickup-timestamp field does not defeat the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08: all three artifacts carry trip identifier TRP-00303 and the trace's first fix at 19:16:48 matches the trip record's start, so the artifacts plainly describe the same trip, and limb (b) is met from an unimpaired trace. The rider's profile does not tighten the burden (deviation_claims_60d is 0). No escal­a­tion trigger fires: identifiers match, timestamps do not run backwards, the refund is below charged_total, and the only tension in the bundle is between the trace and a rounded copy of the same measurement, which POL-RD-01 resolves by rule rather than by weighing comparable evidence.

Confidence is 0.88, capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts — the GPS trace and trip record for the deviation, the fare breakdown for the refund. The monetary effect, SGD 2.70, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Rider and driver, this is the ruling on trip TRP-00305.

THE MEASUREMENT. The charge is SGD 19.85 (EV-FARE-00305, weight 1.0). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00305, weight 1.0; 175 fixes at a 10 s cadence, no gaps, not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c)) records 11.18 km against a booked optimal of 7.6 km (EV-TRIP-00305), an excess of 3.58 km, or 47.1% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment gates pass on the trace figure, which governs over the rounded 11.2 km convenience copy on the trip record. Rider, your claim that a deviation is established is correct as far as the raw measurement goes, but it does not survive the next step.

WHY THE REFUND FAILS. The detour you were charged for is the one you asked for. At 12:10:00, forty seconds after the trip started, you wrote 'uncle can go pasir ris mrt first? my sister pass me something, 5 min only' (EV-CHAT-00305, weight 1.0), and the message carries a platform-resolved waypoint_hint for Pasir Ris MRT (Exit A). The driver answered 'ok can'. The trace shows the vehicle passing 4.57 m from that waypoint at 12:15:30, far inside POL-RD-04's 200 m corroboration test, and the derived waypoint_approach block records within_threshold as true. POL-RD-04 therefore applies: the instruction came from the rider, was given before the vehicle left the optimal corridor, and named a place specific enough to act on. Because you directed the driver to the waypoint 'first', the excursion up to Pasir Ris MRT and back to the corridor is the whole of the 3.58 km excess. That excess is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied, and nothing remains: no deviation survives, POL-RD-02 does not run, and the SGD 19.85 charge stands.

YOUR OBJECTIONS. Your point that the extent of the exclusion is unmeasured is rejected: the corroborated instruction, the 11.18 km trace and the 7.6 km optimal leave no part of the excess attributable to anything else, so there is no residual leg to measure. Your point that the residue would still exceed 20% (a 1.52 km gate, needing an exclusion of more than 2.06 km) is rejected for the same reason: the exclusion here absorbs the whole 3.58 km. Your POL-RD-02 arithmetic — charged_total 19.85 less a recomputed fare of 14.22, giving 5.63 rounded up to 5.65 — is right as arithmetic but never becomes payable, because POL-RD-02 runs only where a deviation is established. POL-RD-14 is not in play, because the trace does corroborate your instruction, and neither is the POL-RD-10(7) contradiction it describes: a request that was made and a route that followed it are consistent.

DRIVER COMPENSATION. Separately from the deviation, the fare ledger billed you for 9.5 km (distance_charged_km on EV-FARE-00305, weight 1.0) while the trace records 11.18 km (EV-GPS-00305), a shortfall of 1.68 km, above the 1.0 km gate. At SGD 0.75 per unbilled kilometre that is SGD 1.26, rounded up to SGD 1.30, well inside the SGD 15.00 cap. This is a payment to the driver, not a refund to the rider; under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same figure.

NO REFERRALS. The excess is 47.1% and 3.58 km, below both materiality gates (50% and 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged; driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over completed_trips_90d of 260, so no pattern is established and no driver-conduct referral arises. No billing-integrity referral either: the fare carries no ERP or toll lines and no gantry the trace never crosses.

THE MISSING ADVISORY. EV-ADVIS-00305-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; it can carry no fact. No party asserted an external traffic cause, so POL-RD-13 does no work and no escalation follows from its absence.

NO ESCALATION. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trace is unimpaired, the trip identifiers on trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all match (TRP-00305), the timestamps are consistent, no refund approaches the ceiling, and every charge line has a counterpart. Confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect, SGD 1.30, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold under POL-GEN-05 and executes on issue.

Rider, the SGD 5.65 you claimed is not payable. Driver, the SGD 19.85 fare stands and you are paid SGD 1.30 for the distance the meter did not bill.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: this is a route-deviation dispute over trip TRP-00306, Yishun MRT to Raffles Place on 8 Aug 2026, charged SGD 42.05 on a metered fare.

Rider — your account of the route is borne out by the platform's own data. The routing engine's optimal distance is 21.0 km (EV-TRIP-00306; optimal is SLE then CTE) and the GPS trace records 33.48 km driven (EV-GPS-00306). Under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs and the rounded 33.5 km on the trip record may not be cited for the threshold test: the excess is 12.48 km, or 59.43% of optimal. Both establishment tests (over 0.8 km and over 20%) pass, and the excess also clears 8.0 km and 50%, so the deviation is MATERIAL. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 265 fixes, 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, empty gaps array and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0.0 s — so the deviation may rest on the trace alone and no corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is needed.

Driver — your explanation that a police roadblock on the SLE forced you onto the BKE cannot be tested against anything. The only traffic advisory for this trip, EV-ADVIS-00306-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, 'No advisory covers the SLE or CTE in this window'), and you named no evidence ID for any advisory. Under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 your assertion is discarded: it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal, and POL-RD-03 is unavailable on this record. Because no party cited an advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged and the case does not escalate on that ground. No other exoneration applies either: the chat log (EV-CHAT-00306) has zero messages, so the POL-RD-04 rider-instruction test cannot be run and nothing is excluded; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null with amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 does not run; and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is irrelevant.

Money. The fare is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 runs. charged_total is SGD 42.05. recomputed_fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 km + 0.28 x 27.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee = SGD 27.91. The POL-RD-02 figure is therefore 42.05 less 27.91 = SGD 14.14, rounded up to SGD 14.15. That is the partial your submission argues for, and it is the correct figure on POL-RD-02 alone.

But that is not the end of it. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is mandatory on a material deviation. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 3, which meets the pattern test on its own limb (3 or more in the trailing 90-day window); those two counters are the only citable profile fields under POL-GEN-01, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter of 7 is context only. This trip's deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on its own trace, so POL-RD-06(b) licenses FULL_REFUND of the charged total rather than the POL-RD-02 partial. The two figures side by side: POL-RD-02 partial SGD 14.15; uplifted figure SGD 42.05. There are no government-set or third-party pass-through lines to carve out — ERP, tolls and any surcharge are all 0.00 on this non-airport trip — so nothing is settled separately under POL-RD-09 and nothing is double-counted under POL-RD-09(1). Your position that the whole-fare demand 'exceeds anything the fare lines can support' is therefore accepted only as to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic and is outweighed by POL-RD-06(b).

Ruling: FULL_REFUND of SGD 42.05 to the rider. Confidence is capped at 1.0 because every artifact carrying a deciding fact — the trace, the trip record, the driver profile and the fare breakdown — carries weight_multiplier 1.0; no impaired artifact carries any deciding fact.

Referral: under POL-RD-06(c) the case is referred to driver-conduct review. That referral rides with the money and does not displace or delay it.

Execution: the monetary effect exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so the amount is issued but held and the case enters the human queue for release.

Audit note: one rider claim was discarded in the mechanical pre-check — a claim about the absent advisory that cited EV-ADVIS-00306-01 at weight 0.0 without naming its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the disclosure requirement of POL-GEN-02(1) was not met. The substance of that point is preserved by the surviving claims above.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
This case cannot be decided on the record; it goes to a human reviewer. The governing reason is POL-RD-07. The GPS trace for trip TRP-00307 (EV-GPS-00307) contains a 240-second gap between consecutive fixes, from 18:16:17 to 18:20:17, and that gap sits inside the KPE stretch this dispute is about. 240 seconds is well over the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely in the schema pre-pass. As POL-GEN-02(3) requires, the artifact is named: EV-GPS-00307 carries weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage 86.7%).

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a), POL-RD-07(ii) says a deviation may NOT be established on the trace alone; it must be corroborated by an independent source. There is none. The in-app chat (EV-CHAT-00307) holds zero messages, so there is no driver admission. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-00307) charges no ERP gantries and shows no off-optimal-corridor pass-through, so the pass-through record places the vehicle on no other corridor. The driver's statement denies the detour rather than admitting the route. And the trip_record distance (22.6 km) is the same measurement as the trace, which POL-RD-01 itself calls a rounded convenience copy of the trace figure and forbids citing for the threshold test, so it is not an independent derivation. With no corroboration, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) make escalation mandatory, and the confidence cap in POL-GEN-02(2) independently puts the case below the 0.70 floor under POL-RD-10(1): the only carrier of the measured excess is the impaired trace at 0.39, and the trip_record figure is a copy of that same measurement rather than a second independent carrier, so the maximum-of-two-carriers rule does not lift the cap. bundle_integrity_score is context only and is not the cap. Escalation is terminal under POL-GEN-03: the SGD 29.95 charge is held, neither collected nor refunded, and no amount moves to either party.

On the surviving claims. The rider is right that on the raw figures the excess is 4.6 km and 25.56%, clear of POL-RD-01's 20% and 0.8 km tests, and right that rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d of 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 0 raise no added corroboration burden under POL-RD-08. But the governing distance comes from an impaired trace, so the threshold test cannot be run to establish the deviation while that trace stands uncorroborated: the limb is undecided over the impaired stretch and supports neither a refund nor a payment. The rider's asserted refund, had the trace been clean, would be SGD 5.15 (charged_total 29.95 less recomputed_fare 24.82 = 5.13, rounded up to the nearest 0.05 under POL-RD-02); that figure is not awarded.

The driver is right that his profile shows no repeat-deviation pattern - deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 260 completed trips in 90 days - so no POL-RD-06 uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arise - and right that the sampled speeds (43.5 to 46.9 kph, with no stationary fix) show no off-corridor stop. Those points confirm only that nothing is proven either way; they do not convert an undecidable stretch into a finding for the driver.

The traffic advisory for this trip is absent: EV-ADVIS-00307-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0. The driver's traffic assertion ('KPE straight down, no exit. GPS always drops in the tunnel') therefore carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and POL-RD-13 confirms it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route. POL-RD-13 expressly preserves POL-RD-10(3) where, as here, the trace itself is impaired and no independent corroboration exists, so the missing advisory does not change the disposition in either direction.

No driver compensation is due: the fare billed 22.6 km, the same as the trace, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall over 1.0 km under POL-RD-04. No referral is issued, because no clause on these facts produces one: there is no POL-RD-06 pattern and no POL-RD-09(4) phantom gantry or surcharge line.

What would resolve this for the reviewer: an ERP gantry record for the trip, a GPS export restoring the fixes across the 18:16-18:20 tunnel gap, or a platform-derived distance independent of this trace. Any one of those would let POL-RD-07(ii) run and the deviation be decided on its merits. The open question of what happened inside the tunnel belongs to the reviewer, not to a ruling made now.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this dispute turns on an upfront-quoted fare, and the fare stands. To the rider — the route finding is yours; the money is not. Measured on the governing trace figure (EV-GPS-00308, trace_distance_km 12.2 km, the field POL-RD-01 makes govern over the rounded trip_record copy) against the booked optimum (EV-TRIP-00308, optimal_distance_km 9.0 km), the excess is 3.2 km, or 35.56%, which clears both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (above 0.8 km and above 20%): the deviation is ESTABLISHED. Ruling on dispute DSP-00311 (trip TRP-00311). Both of you read the same records; here is what they show and how the money is fixed.

DEVIATION. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00311 (weight 1.0) measures the trip at 12.4 km, against the booked optimal of 7.5 km on the AYE (EV-TRIP-00311). The excess is 4.9 km — 65.3% of optimal — so both POL-RD-01 tests pass: the deviation is ESTABLISHED, and at over 50% it is additionally MATERIAL. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (145 fixes at a 10-second cadence, no gaps), so it carries the finding on its own and POL-RD-07/POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged.

RIDER-REQUESTED STOP. The driver says the rider asked for Clementi. The chat log EV-CHAT-00311 does show her 16:06:05 request and his 'ok', but POL-RD-04 requires the trace to corroborate a rider instruction, and the nearest fix to the waypoint the platform resolved from that message (The Clementi Mall) is 2,595.3 m away against the 200 m threshold — the vehicle never approached it. Under POL-RD-14 the instruction therefore did not cause the excess: no distance is excluded and no amended optimal is supplied. The driver's further account of a 'never mind, go straight' message does not appear in the complete, untruncated two-message export, and he does not rely on it.

TRAFFIC. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00311-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0; issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no advisory on file covers this trip, POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and no external traffic cause exonerates any part of the excess (POL-RD-13). The deviation stands at the measured figure, and the finding does not rest on that absent artifact.

MONEY. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 fixes the refund arithmetically. Read from EV-FARE-00311: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 7.5 km + 0.28 x 12.0 min) x the fare breakdown's surge multiplier of 1.00, plus 0.80 platform fee, plus zero ERP, tolls, surcharges, waiting time and promo = 13.585. Charged_total is 20.62. Refund = 20.62 - 13.585 = 7.035, rounded up to SGD 7.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and is 34.1% of the charge — short of the 90% that would make it a FULL_REFUND — so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.05.

On the driver's point that the award cannot exceed the SGD 5.00 recorded as contested: POL-RD-02 measures the refund as charged_total less the recomputed fare and no clause caps it at the contested figure. The record supports a fare correction of SGD 7.05, and that is the amount awarded; the tribunal corrects the bill to the correct fare rather than to the figure the rider happened to name.

Nothing is added for ERP, tolls or surcharges — none was charged (0.00) — so POL-RD-09 produces no pass-through correction, there is no unmatched line, and no billing-integrity referral arises. The POL-RD-06 profile check was run as the MATERIAL finding requires (0 deviation flags in 90 days on 260 completed trips): no pattern is established, so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Driver compensation under POL-RD-04 is not available either: the distance billed (12.4 km) is not less than the trace records.

On the driver's own chosen reason code the fee is not chargeable.

EV-GPS-00403 (weight 1.0) reports 0 qualifying in-radius fixes across its 73 driver fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. The arrival block's 0 counter is not neutralised by the unpublished accuracy datum: POL-NS-02 asks for a fix with REPORTED accuracy of 25 m or better, and a fix without one cannot satisfy that test, so the clause's own direction applies (no qualifying in-radius fix means the driver never arrived). POL-NS-04 also exonerates the rider: 'where are you? im at the block' was sent at 09:12:00 inside the waiting window (limb (a)); no chat reply came within 120 seconds and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, the driver cancelling 270 seconds later (limb (b)); and the rider track places her within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius on all 44 qualifying fixes, mean 14.6 m, maximum 19.1 m (limb (c)).

5. Arguments rejected. (i) The record's own 390-second clock (09:10:00 to 09:16:30) does not satisfy limb (c): POL-NS-01(c) expressly measures the dwell from GPS entry into the geofence, not from the arrival tap, and the trace never enters it. (ii) The system chat message 'Your driver has arrived' at 09:10:01 (EV-CHAT-00410, weight 1.0) is not a second, independent carrier of the arrival fact: it is generated from the same button press, and if the instrument evidence were removed it would support nothing, so it is a restatement and does not lift the POL-GEN-02(2) cap to 1.0. (iii) The SGD 3.20 driver compensation (derived.money.driver_compensation) is conditional on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not. (iv) The anti-farming check is passed — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/120 = 0.008 (not above 0.08) — so nothing is withheld on that ground and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged by it. (v) POL-NS-03 does not take over: it requires a stationary dwell of 300 s within 400 m of the pin, and the 377.4 m figure is a moving approach, not a dwell; registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises either. (vi) Escalation under POL-NS-09(b) is declined. That trigger requires that no clause resolve the trip-record/trace conflict, and POL-NS-05 resolves it by testing and falsifying the button-pressed marker; POL-NS-12 is not open (it covers GPS_AUTO arrivals only, and this marker is BUTTON), and POL-NS-09(a), (c) and (e) are not engaged.

6. Weight and confidence. EV-TRIP-00410 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, and both sides disclosed it as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The tag is schema-level: it meets none of POL-NS-08's limbs (a) to (d) — the 09:10:00 event matches a trace fix to within seconds, the trace has no gap over 120 s and carries 84 fixes, the chat holds exactly the 2 messages the trip record counts, and the $4.00 fare line equals the cancellation fee in force ($4.00, identical to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd). It is therefore down-weighted under POL-GEN-02 only and does not decide the case: the deciding facts are the driver's position (EV-GPS-00410, weight 1.0) and the fee charged (EV-FARE-00410, weight 1.0), so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no POL-NS-08 closing-sentence escalation applies. Confidence 0.90.

The monetary effect, $4.00, is below the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes automatically on issue; both parties may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

This case cannot be decided on the record and goes to a human reviewer. The disputed S$4.00 cancellation fee for TRP-00411 is held — not collected and not refunded — until that review is complete.

What the record shows. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00411, weight 1.0) carries a driver-pressed 'arrived' marker at 20:21:45 and a driver cancellation at 20:27:45 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event: 360 seconds, longer than the 300-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the 180-second default does not apply, and no_show_threshold_sec is null). The chat log (EV-CHAT-00411, weight 1.0) shows 'here' at 20:22:05, 'where? i dont see' at 20:23:15 and 'at the block' at 20:23:40 — three messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count, so no chat defect under POL-NS-08(c). The fare ledger (EV-FARE-00411, weight 1.0) shows a S$4.00 cancellation-fee line equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of S$4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd S$0.00, so there is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d).

Why the case cannot be decided. POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold. Limbs (a) and (d) are made out on the trip record alone, but limb (b) is decided by the gps_trace, and EV-GPS-00411 is MISSING — weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, payload null (named as POL-GEN-02(3) requires). There is no qualifying in-geofence fix within the 50 m STANDARD radius at any time, because there is no fix at all. Under POL-NS-02 a trace that cannot establish the in-radius readings is impaired rather than proof of absence, so the geofence test could not be run: limb (b) is neither satisfied nor failed. Limb (c)'s dwell runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and so never starts; the 360 seconds between two driver-set markers cannot stand in for a GPS-measured dwell. POL-NS-12 supplies nothing here: it applies only where arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO and the record carries the platform's own arrival event with wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired, and this record has arrival_marker BUTTON and no events array, so there is no platform-confirmed arrival independent of the export. The driver's account ('I was at Blk 51 ... waited six minutes') is offered in the place of the test that admitted no reading; it does not supply the missing measurement, does not lift the confidence cap, and does not stop the absent trace being the only evidence of where the vehicle was.

Consequence. The sole evidence for the deciding fact — the driver's position during the waiting window — is the impaired trace, so the confidence cap is its weight of 0.0 (POL-GEN-02(2)), below the 0.70 confidence floor, and POL-NS-09(e) applies as well. POL-NS-09 is terminal: no monetary ruling issues, the S$4.00 is held, and no referral is produced because no clause here produces one.

The claims, answered. The rider's argument that 'no qualifying fix' from an absent trace makes limb (b) fail and earns a full refund is rejected: a test that could not be run is not evidence the driver was elsewhere (POL-NS-02's sparse-trace sentence; POL-NS-11). POL-NS-06 cannot refund the fee either, because it needs the dwell computed under POL-NS-02 and there is no dwell to compute; the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00411-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) makes limb (i) unavailable in any event. POL-NS-05 records no false-arrival referral, because neither trigger (over 300 m from the pin, or motion at 15 km/h or more) can be shown without a fix. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider — the driver replied 25 seconds after her message, inside the 120-second window — which the rider fairly concedes, and rider presence is undecidable under POL-NS-11. The driver's POL-NS-07 claim for S$3.20 is not payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limbs (b) and (c) cannot be established; the anti-farming check does not trip in any event (1 no-show termination in 30 days against a threshold of 4; 1/120 = 0.008 against 0.08), so nothing under POL-NS-09(c) or (d) is engaged either.

Open question for the reviewer: whether the platform's own full-resolution location stream for TRP-00411 places the driver inside the 50 m pickup radius around 20:21:45 to 20:27:45, and for how long continuously. That measurement — a record-type item either party may add under POL-GEN-04(b) — decides the case: a qualifying in-geofence dwell of 300 seconds or more from the first qualifying fix means the fee stands and S$3.20 is payable to the driver; no qualifying fix means the S$4.00 is refunded in full to the rider. The amount is below the S$8.00 automatic-execution threshold, but as no monetary ruling issues it stays held pending review.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To both parties — this is the provisional ruling on trip TRP-00412. The driver's waiting time was too short, so the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

The figures. The driver accepted at 12:40:30, his first qualifying in-geofence fix at the Sembawang MRT (Exit A) pin is at 12:45:20, and the trip was terminated at 12:48:40. That is a single continuous stationary dwell inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius of 200 seconds (21 qualifying fixes, closest approach 3.89 m). The free waiting period in force on this trip is 300 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec as fee_schedule.resolution_rule directs ('platform_policy first, defaults otherwise'); the 180-second fee_schedule default never comes into play on this record. The dwell is therefore 100 seconds short.

Why that decides it. POL-NS-01(c) requires a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force before a RIDER_NO_SHOW fee is chargeable, and the same shortfall breaks limb (d): a termination at 12:48:40 precedes the elapse of the dwell the clause requires. POL-NS-06 then makes the cancellation fee not chargeable and refundable in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. POL-NS-06 limb (i) cannot rescue the fee: the trace shows one in-geofence interval only (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for it to add to the first, and the traffic_advisory the limb requires, EV-ADVIS-00412-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — its absence is citable but exonerates nobody, and asserting it against a MISSING artifact is precisely what POL-NS-09 guards against.

Claims I accepted. The driver's own concession that the fee fails on the 200-second dwell is accepted and is the ground of this ruling, as is the rider's parallel arithmetic and her reading of the 300-second waiting period. The arrival itself is not in issue: POL-NS-02 is satisfied by 21 consecutive in-radius fixes, and POL-NS-05 does not fire, because the 'arrived' marker at 12:45:20 coincides exactly with the first qualifying in-geofence fix — it was neither posted from beyond 300 m nor posted at 15 km/h or more — so no false-arrival referral is entered against the driver. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider and I do not rely on it: the chat log holds only the system arrival notice and the driver's 'exit A', and the rider sent no locating or coordinating message, so limb (a) fails at once, whatever limb (c) shows. That does not help the driver either, because POL-NS-06 refunds on the dwell arithmetic alone.

Claims I rejected or put aside. The driver's submission that the rider was not at the pickup point is rejected: the rider's track shows 23 stationary fixes 68.0 m to 76.0 m from the pin (mean 72.2 m) across the whole window, and the threshold that governs rider presence is the 100 m rider_presence_radius_m for a STANDARD zone, not the 50 m driver-arrival radius. In any event the rider's presence or absence cannot save a fee that fails on dwell. The driver's 'this rider's history speaks for itself' is put aside under POL-GEN-01: prior_no_show_flags (6) and rating (3.82) are context only and cannot carry any finding about this trip; the only rider no-show field the policy reads is no_show_disputes_30d, which is 1, and the driver's own rating (4.97) and lifetime trips (4,200) are equally context only. Nothing is discarded for this — both advocates cited those fields only to say they are context-only, which is correct, so no claim was discarded on that ground.

No escalation and no referral. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: my confidence (0.95) is above the 0.70 floor; the trip record and the GPS trace agree on arrival, dwell and termination, so there is no unresolvable contradiction; neither party shows a dispute with the other in the trailing 90 days; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the threshold of 3; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips, ratio 0.008, and both limbs must be met); and the deciding facts rest on COMPLETE, weight-1.0 artifacts, so no POL-NS-08(a)–(d) impairment makes escalation mandatory. No clause produces a referral on this disposition: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker is true, and POL-NS-01's driver-education item is for a mis-selected reason code, whereas RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

The money, and execution. fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is $4.00, which reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of $4.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect; payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the rider is still carrying the disputed $4.00. The refund is the whole of that cancellation-fee line: $4.00. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 conditions the payout (80% of the $4.00 fee, the money block's $3.20) on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, and it is not. The monetary effect, $4.00, is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically; either party may appeal once, within 30 days, under POL-GEN-04.
